source.label: theorem:2
source.quote: The \regret of Tsallis-INF with $\eta_t = \frac{4}{\sqrt{t}}$ and reduced variance loss estimators defined in equation \eqref{eq:rv}, in any adversarial bandit problem satisfies \Reg \leq 2\sqrt{(K-1)T}+\frac{1}{2}\sqrt{T}+14K\log(T) + \frac{3}{4}\sqrt{K} + 15.

results.notes: Pseudo-regret defined against best arm in expectation; adaptive adversary allowed.

conditions: Delta has a unique zero entry i*

source.label: theorem:2
source.quote: Furthermore, if there exists a vector $\Delta \in [0,1]^K$ with a unique zero entry $i^*$ ... and a constant $C\geq 0$, such that the pseudo-regret at time $T$ satisfies the $(\Delta, C, T)$ self-bounding constraint ..., then the \regret additionally satisfies: \overline{Reg}_T \leq \sum_{i\neq i*} \frac{1}{\Delta_i}\lr{\lr{\log \frac{T(K-1)}{\lr{\sum_{i\neq i^*} \frac{1}{\Delta_i}}^2}} + 6} + 28K \log(T) + \frac{3}{2}\sqrt{K} + 30 + C.

results.notes: C here is the self-bounding constant (C_sb); for stochastic bandits with corruption C, C_sb = 2C. Covers stochastic and stochastically constrained adversarial regimes (C_sb = 0).
